issue.description: User-authorized extraction of the existing start launcher into the independent harness-start Forgejo repository. Plan: docs/plan/plan.md. Acceptance: standalone installer; signed automatic and explicit updates; configurable agent/model/permission/tmux defaults; offline updater, installer, CLI and real tmux validation; protected iad-ci Transit release workflow deployed through declarative-config; signed first release published and mirrored; bootstrap transition prepared/published without capturing concurrent checkout edits; installed launcher verified. One owning bead covers application source, bootstrap adoption and GitOps release manifests. No speculative child work.
issue.notes: Implemented standalone launcher, generated authenticated installer, signed automatic/explicit updates, agent-update control, configurable models/permission/tmux/workdir, release tooling, signed-source bootstrap adoption, and offline/runtime tests. Source extraction: bootstrap main 32993be. Initial source commit 69beb0b published to public Forgejo harness-start, with server-side GitHub mirror confirmed. Complete local gate BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE=/home/coding/bootstrap scripts/check.sh passed, including private tmux runtime uid1000 and bootstrap bridge fixture. gitleaks dir . --redact --no-banner passed. GitOps: declarative-config/k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/harness-start-release-sign-workflowtemplate.yml and harness-start-bootstrap-adopt-workflowtemplate.yml, commit d2944c9; iad-ci Application argo-workflows-ns-iad-ci reports both Synced. Static YAML, embedded shell and signer-token isolation checks passed. check-resource-limits.py iad-ci: 531 files,269 existing findings,0 critical. Capacity through read-only proxy: 7 nodes,30.50 CPU/83.82Gi allocatable,19.55CPU/38.14Gi committed, sufficient burst headroom. Parent Application was already OutOfSync/Degraded before delivery; current Degraded transition predates changes (06:46 UTC), no new conditions. One-shot Workflows are excluded by ArgoCD; removed ineffective GitOps request in 16527227 and use documented manual template references with refreshed credentials. First run harness-start-release-sign-manual-s825h failed at the runtime root guard before signing/pushing. Fixed gate to copy exact runtime inputs into disposable /tmp directory and run as nobody via runuser; removed redundant dependency on real sudo (test always supplies its own double). sudo -n env PATH="$PATH" bash scripts/check.sh passed complete locally including real tmux uid65534. Normal complete gate with bootstrap fixture also passed. Outstanding: rerun signed release, mirror/artifact convergence, bootstrap bridge publication, installed launcher verification. Do not close.
